findings: Southern/Hal Leonard identifies Sonata op.4 no.11 in F minor, Harvey Pittel arrangement, soprano saxophone, SU317 / HL3776210, 28 pages.
Crystal Records confirms exact Pittel recording on S105 with Malcolm Hamilton, harpsichord, Robert Adcock, cello. Eastman archive credits Pittel/Hamilton arrangement from recorder/continuo.
Kutztown University includes the specific sonata/Pittel version in soprano repertoire.
Source-work movements Largo, Allegro, Sarabanda (Adagio), Allegro appear in exact recorder recording metadata. That recording is not the saxophone edition.
